sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Evo Morales inaugurated as first indigenous president
geopolitical_news.summary: The coca-grower leader takes office in January promising nationalization and constitutional reform.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hydrocarbons nationalized on May Day
geopolitical_news.summary: Morales decrees state control of gas fields, forcing foreign firms to renegotiate contracts.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying struggles
sport.summary: Bolivia finishes near the bottom of CONMEBOL qualifying for Germany 2006.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constituent assembly deadlock deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Fights over the new constitution and Sucre's capital status turn violent in November.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nationalizations expand to mining
geopolitical_news.summary: The government takes over the Vinto tin smelter and moves against foreign miners.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Bolivia draws twice but fails to reach the knockout rounds in Venezuela.

geopolitical_news.headline: Autonomy referendums defy La Paz
geopolitical_news.summary: Eastern 'media luna' departments approve autonomy statutes the government calls illegal.

geopolitical_news.headline: US ambassador expelled
geopolitical_news.summary: Morales expels Philip Goldberg in September, accusing him of backing separatists.

sport.headline: FIFA altitude-ban controversy
sport.summary: FIFA briefly bans high-altitude qualifiers, threatening Bolivia's La Paz home advantage.

geopolitical_news.headline: New constitution approved
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters back Morales's charter in a January referendum, allowing his re-election later that year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morales wins second term
geopolitical_news.summary: He is re-elected in December with about two-thirds of the vote.

sport.headline: Historic 6-1 rout of Argentina
sport.summary: Bolivia thrashes Maradona's Argentina in La Paz, the visitors' worst defeat in decades.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Gasolinazo' fuel hike reversed
geopolitical_news.summary: Morales scraps a steep fuel price rise after days of nationwide protests in December.

geopolitical_news.headline: Judicial elections held
geopolitical_news.summary: Bolivia holds the world's first popular vote for top judges in October.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying failure
sport.summary: Bolivia again finishes near the foot of the table for South Africa 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: TIPNIS highway protests
geopolitical_news.summary: An indigenous march against a road through a national park is violently dispersed in September.

geopolitical_news.headline: Police mutiny over pay
geopolitical_news.summary: Low-ranking officers protest in June, briefly occupying plazas nationwide.

sport.headline: Copa América group exit
sport.summary: Bolivia draws all three matches but fails to advance in Argentina.

geopolitical_news.headline: Spanish utility REE nationalized
geopolitical_news.summary: Morales expropriates Red Eléctrica's Bolivian grid in May, straining ties with Madrid.

geopolitical_news.headline: Colquiri mine clashes
geopolitical_news.summary: Rival miners fight over the tin mine, forcing a government takeover.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying campaign falters
sport.summary: Bolivia's hopes for Brazil 2014 fade with heavy away defeats.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morales's plane diverted in Snowden affair
geopolitical_news.summary: European airspace closures force his jet to land in Vienna in July amid US pressure.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sea-access case filed against Chile
geopolitical_news.summary: Bolivia takes its claim for sovereign Pacific access to the International Court of Justice.

sport.headline: Altitude debate resurfaces
sport.summary: FIFA again discusses high-altitude matches as Bolivia leans on its La Paz fortress.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morales wins third term
geopolitical_news.summary: He is re-elected in October with about 60 percent of the vote.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pope Francis visits Bolivia
geopolitical_news.summary: The July visit draws huge crowds in El Alto and Santa Cruz.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying ends in failure
sport.summary: Bolivia finishes second-to-last in a dismal CONMEBOL campaign, missing the Brazil 2014 World Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ruling party loses key regions
geopolitical_news.summary: The opposition wins La Paz and El Alto in March local elections.

geopolitical_news.headline: ICJ hears sea-access case
geopolitical_news.summary: The Hague holds hearings on Bolivia's claim against Chile.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final run
sport.summary: Bolivia reaches the knockouts for the first time in 18 years, losing to Peru.

geopolitical_news.headline: Referendum rejects fourth Morales term
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters narrowly say No in February to letting Morales run again in 2019.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cooperative miners kill deputy minister
geopolitical_news.summary: Rodolfo Illanes is beaten to death during protests in August.

sport.headline: Copa América Centenario group exit
sport.summary: Bolivia loses all three matches in the United States.

geopolitical_news.headline: Court allows Morales re-election bid
geopolitical_news.summary: The constitutional court scraps term limits in November, overriding the 2016 referendum.

geopolitical_news.headline: Water crisis hits La Paz
geopolitical_news.summary: Severe drought depletes reservoirs, forcing water rationing across La Paz neighborhoods for months.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying ends
sport.summary: Bolivia misses Russia 2018 despite strong home form in La Paz.

geopolitical_news.headline: ICJ rejects Bolivia's sea claim
geopolitical_news.summary: The court rules in October that Chile has no obligation to negotiate ocean access.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morales confirms 2019 candidacy
geopolitical_news.summary: He announces his re-election bid despite the referendum defeat.

sport.headline: No World Cup for Bolivia
sport.summary: The team watches Russia 2018 from home after another failed campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Disputed election sparks crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: Morales claims victory in October amid fraud allegations; an OAS audit finds irregularities.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morales resigns and flees
geopolitical_news.summary: After military pressure in November, he resigns and accepts asylum in Mexico.

geopolitical_news.headline: Áñez takes interim presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: Senator Jeanine Áñez declares herself president amid deadly clashes in Sacaba and Senkata.

sport.headline: Copa América group exit
sport.summary: Bolivia loses all three group matches in Brazil, extending its Copa América winless streak.

geopolitical_news.headline: Arce wins election, MAS returns
geopolitical_news.summary: Luis Arce wins October's vote outright, and Morales returns from exile in November.

geopolitical_news.headline: Interim government ends
geopolitical_news.summary: The Áñez interim administration oversees the twice-postponed elections amid the COVID-19 pandemic.

sport.headline: Football halted by pandemic
sport.summary: Domestic leagues and World Cup qualifiers are suspended for months by COVID-19.

geopolitical_news.headline: Áñez arrested over 2019 crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: The former interim president is detained in March on sedition and terrorism charges.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID vaccination campaign
geopolitical_news.summary: Bolivia rolls out vaccines amid a deadly second wave of infections.

sport.headline: Copa América group exit
sport.summary: Bolivia loses all five matches in Brazil, conceding heavily in a dismal Copa América campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Census dispute fuels Santa Cruz strike
geopolitical_news.summary: A 36-day civic strike demands an earlier census to reset funding and legislative seats.

geopolitical_news.headline: Camacho arrested
geopolitical_news.summary: The Santa Cruz governor is detained in December over the 2019 political crisis.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying failure
sport.summary: Bolivia misses the Qatar 2022 World Cup, finishing second-to-last in CONMEBOL qualifying.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lithium deals signed
geopolitical_news.summary: Bolivia signs extraction deals with Chinese and Russian firms for its vast reserves.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fuel and dollar shortages bite
geopolitical_news.summary: Diesel scarcities and a parallel exchange rate signal deepening economic stress.

sport.headline: Martins retires from national team
sport.summary: All-time top scorer Marcelo Martins Moreno bows out in November.

geopolitical_news.headline: Failed coup attempt shakes La Paz
geopolitical_news.summary: General Zúñiga storms the presidential palace with troops in June before backing down.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economic crisis deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Dollar shortages and fuel lines worsen as foreign reserves dwindle.

sport.headline: Shock qualifying win over Colombia
sport.summary: Bolivia beats Colombia 1-0 in El Alto, reigniting 2026 World Cup hopes.

geopolitical_news.headline: Right wins presidency, ending MAS era
geopolitical_news.summary: Rodrigo Paz wins the October runoff, closing two decades of leftist rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economic emergency declared
geopolitical_news.summary: The new government inherits empty reserves, fuel shortages and soaring prices.

sport.headline: World Cup playoff berth secured
sport.summary: Bolivia clinches seventh place and the inter-confederation playoff for 2026.
